brief:
The Palestinian ambassador to Britain has called on the UK government to intervene after an international travel event in London advertised an Israeli agency linked to settlements, Middle East Eye reported. The ambassador's demand follows the outlet's disclosure of the agency's involvement in the London-based gathering.

Details of the specific agency and the nature of the settlement connections were not outlined in the available account of the ambassador's statement.
